content_sections.heading: KMSCL Assistant Manager (IT) Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Assistant Manager (IT) post.

content_sections.heading: KMSCL Assistant Manager (IT) Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must be citizens of India. Minimum 2 years of post-qualification experience in the relevant field. The cut-off date for experience is 01.10.2026.

rows.qualification_required: B.Tech/BE in Computer Science/MCA from a recognized University/Institute. Equivalency certificate required for equivalent qualifications.

content_sections.heading: KMSCL Assistant Manager (IT) Age Limit
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 40 years as of 01.10.2026.

rows.relaxation: As per Govt. of Kerala norms

content_sections.heading: KMSCL Assistant Manager (IT) Application Fee
content_sections.text: The notification does not mention any application fee.

content_sections.heading: KMSCL Assistant Manager (IT) Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process may include application screening, criteria-based screening, a written test, group discussion, skill test/proficiency test, an interview, or any combination of these methods as determined by CMD.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KMSCL Assistant Manager (IT)
content_sections.text: Visit the official Centre for Management Development (CMD) website at www.cmd.kerala.gov.in. Go through the detailed notification carefully to ensure eligibility. Fill up all relevant fields of the online application form completely and accurately. Scan and upload the latest photograph in *.JPG format (size less than 200 kB). Scan and upload a full signature on a white paper in *.JPG format (size less than 50 kB; initials and CAPITAL LETTERS not permitted). Submit the online application before the last date. Keep a printout or digital copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Original or provisional educational qualification certificates (mark sheets, consolidated mark sheets, or statements are not accepted) Equivalency certificate (if applicable for qualifications or foreign degrees) Caste/category certificate for age relaxation (from a competent authority) Work experience certificates with specific information like date of joining, relieving, duties, responsibilities, signature, and seal of authorised person (Affidavit applicable only for latest experience)

content_sections.heading: KMSCL Assistant Manager (IT) Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Incomplete or incorrect application forms will be summarily rejected. Candidates must upload original or provisional certificates instead of mark sheets or consolidated grade cards. Appointment letters, salary certificates, and payslips will not be accepted in lieu of work experience certificates; an affidavit is accepted only for the latest experience. Only shortlisted candidates will receive intimations via email, SMS, or phone call regarding the selection process. Applicants should maintain a valid personal email ID and mobile number active throughout the recruitment process. Applications with blurred or illegible photographs, signatures, or ambiguous experience certificates will be rejected. CMD and KMSCL reserve the right to modify, cancel, or revise the notification at any time.

faq.question: Q1. What is the KMSCL Assistant Manager (IT) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by the Centre for Management Development (CMD) on behalf of Kerala Medical Services Corporation Limited (KMSCL) to appoint 1 Assistant Manager (IT) on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under KMSCL Assistant Manager (IT) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Assistant Manager (IT) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for KMSCL Assistant Manager (IT) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 20 October 2026 at 05:00 P.M.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for KMSCL Assistant Manager (IT)?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Tech/BE in Computer Science or an MCA from a recognized University or Institute, along with a minimum of 2 years of post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for KMSCL Assistant Manager (IT)?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years as of 01.10.2026, with age relaxations applicable for SC/ST/OBC/PWD and other eligible categories as per Government of Kerala norms.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for KMSCL Assistant Manager (IT)?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for KMSCL Assistant Manager (IT)?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website of the Centre for Management Development (CMD) at www.cmd.kerala.gov.in.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly remuneration for KMSCL Assistant Manager (IT)?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly remuneration of ₹33,600.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for KMSCL Assistant Manager (IT)?
faq.answer: The selection process may include application screening, criteria-based screening, written test, group discussion, skill test/proficiency test, interview, or any combination of these methods.

faq.question: Q10. When will the exam date for KMSCL Assistant Manager (IT) be announced?
faq.answer: The examination or interview date has not been specified in the notification and will be intimated to shortlisted candidates later.
